title: Signal-preserving shard sampler for in-situ calibration datasets
creator: Ava Chen
summary: Create a sampling pipeline that shards production traffic into signal-preserving buckets and produces per-domain, size-constrained calibration packs tailored for FP8/INT8 quant profiles and downstream accuracy validation.
description:
Background: Our quantization validation requires representative calibration datasets for each domain/tenant to measure accuracy regressions when applying FP8 or INT8 profiles. Current samplers either over-sample frequent intents or collapse rare but critical signals, causing skewed calibration and inconsistent accuracy results.

Objective: Implement a 'shard sampler' that partitions live traffic by lightweight fingerprints (session, domain, intent sketch) and maintains a reservoir-per-shard with hybrid importance weights so packs preserve both common patterns and sparse but high-utility examples. Packs should be exportable as compact JSONL with metadata for downstream quant workflows and eval runs.

Key constraints: pack sizes typically 1k-10k prompts (configurable per-domain), privacy-preserving (no PII), low cost to maintain continuous rolling packs, and compatibility with the eval harness and our FP8/INT8 calibration pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Sampler produces per-domain packs with configured size and a documented shard-to-example ratio
Calibration packs achieve at least 95% coverage of top-20 intents for the domain and at least 5% representation of long-tail intents (configurable threshold)
Compatibility: generated JSONL includes required fields for quant pipeline (prompt, response, tokenized_lengths, fingerprint, timestamp, domain) and imports cleanly into evals harness
End-to-end smoke: run FP8 and INT8 calibration on one model using produced pack and see stable accuracy deltas within defined tolerances compared to baseline (see test_plan)
Automated nightly job validates pack freshness and emits alerts when domain pack entropy drops below threshold
implementation_plan: 1) Design shard key: lightweight fingerprint combining domain ID, coarse user intent hash, and length bucket
2) Implement streaming collector that annotates and forwards candidate examples to per-shard reservoirs (memory-backed, with periodic flush to object store)
3) Reservoir policy: base reservoir sampling + importance reweighting by rarity score and utility signal (e.g., model perplexity, downstream metric impact)
4) Post-process step: dedupe by similarity sketch, stratify by length buckets and label coverage, export pack manifest and JSONL payload
5) Integrate pack metadata with quant pipeline: include target quant profile tags (fp8/int8 variants) and seed for deterministic sampling
6) Add observability: per-domain pack size, age, entropy, intent-coverage, and top-k examples surfaced in Console
7) Run cross-checks: small holdout, run quantization calibration, and validate accuracy metrics; iterate on weighting heuristics
progress_updates: 2026-02-18: Spike complete comparing several shard key formulations; found domain+intent-hash+len-bucket gave best balance between collision rate and state cardinality
2026-02-25: Prototype reservoir implemented in Rust service; demoed streaming ingestion with synthetic traffic to infra team
2026-03-03: Early post-process dedupe using simhash reduced duplicate rate by 28% on sample domains
2026-03-09: Integration plan reviewed by MLOps and Evals; requested deterministic export seed and additional metadata fields for audit
decisions: Use hybrid reservoir sampling: unbiased base reservoir + importance multiplier for rarity/utility instead of pure stratified sampling
Keep pack sizes configurable per-domain with a default 5k examples to balance compute cost for FP8/INT8 calibration
Avoid storing raw PII: PII detection pipeline will redact or drop sensitive examples before reservoir ingestion
open_questions: What numeric thresholds for 'rare intent' should we expose to customers vs keep internal?
Should we include multiple calibration slices per domain (e.g., short/medium/long) or keep one mixed pack?
Do we provide a user-facing option to pin specific example IDs into a pack for customer-supplied calibration examples?
test_plan: Unit tests for shard key generation and reservoir eviction policy
Synthetic replay runs: validate coverage metrics and distribution similarity to production sample (KL divergence < 0.08 for top-50 token n-grams)

Integration: use generated packs to run FP8 and INT8 calibration on 3 models; collect metrics: token perplexity delta, BLEU/ROUGE variation for classification/generation tasks, and an application-level correctness score
Acceptance thresholds: median token-level perplexity change < 1.5x relative to calibration baseline and application-level pass rate within 2 percentage points
Regression tests: nightly job that re-runs a deterministic quant validation on a golden pack and records time-series
rollout_plan: Canary: enable for 3 low-traffic domains for 2 weeks and compare pack coverage/entropy vs current sampler
Expand: add 20 more domains and run full FP8/INT8 validation before enabling in Dedicated/Private deployments
GA: expose configuration UI in Console for pack size and rarity thresholds; enable alerts and roll-back knob
risks: High cardinality of shards could create memory pressure on streaming collector; mitigation: limit shard state with LRU and fold low-volume shards into 'misc' bucket
Overfitting to short-term traffic spikes if recency weighting is too strong; mitigation: tune decay windows and enforce minimum representation of long-tail
Customer data sensitivity: ensure PII redaction pipeline meets compliance before persisting packs
